 > **PROP-051 safety gates (added 2026-05-21 after the workspace-sync mass-delete disaster):** `monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md` now contains four fail-closed safety gates (A1–A4): degraded-mode prohibitions (prompt-level), pre-clone disk-pressure gate, post-clone working-tree-size check, pre-push delete-sanity gate. If any gate fires, workspace-sync writes `monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-abort-*.json` or `monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-delete-gate-*.json` and exits without commit. Tinker and the integrity agent should scan for these sentinels on their next run; the operator inspects them before re-enabling/proceeding. Workstream B (clone hygiene: `--depth 50`, EXIT trap, start-of-run stale-clone sweep) and Workstream C (`monitor/scripts/prune-integrity.js` for `monitor/integrity/` retention windows) are companions to A. **PROP-127 (added 2026-07-09):** the workspace-sync pre-push hook (`monitor/scripts/lint-workspace-sync-push.js`, PROP-121) now also blocks sentinel-file byte-reversions via CHECK 3 — pushing any of {wins.json, sections.json, predictions.json, uncounted-failures.json, index.html, open/closed-issues.json, expansion-tracker.json, attention-inbox.json} back to a historic commit's content is refused unless `monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-reversion-override.flag` is present. CHECK 3 is fail-open on internal error (unlike CHECKS 1/2 which fail-closed) — a hook bug degrades to pre-PROP-127 status quo rather than blocking all syncs, preserving FUSE→git rescue latency. **PROP-130 (added 2026-07-11):** `monitor/status.json` has a documented two-writer race — poller commits its own fields git-only, decider's FUSE write of `last_run` arms an mtime, workspace-sync's whole-file smart_copy then publishes a chimera (fresh `last_run` + stale poll fields). Instead of a structural fix (single-writer refactor, per-writer file split), integrity runs `monitor/scripts/check-status-json-provenance.js` daily (Section 9d) — read-only canary that walks the last 30 commits touching status.json and flags monotonic-timestamp regressions + `consecutive_quiet_polls` decreases-to-nonzero + `chimera=true` (regression + advancement in same commit = a88d026 signature). RC=3 → moderate `status-json-provenance` finding. Poller's existing self-heal remains the backstop (~24h max damage window). Instrumentation-only close of ISS-2962; detected first live chimera on the ratification-day canary run (workspace-sync commit `27bf1e4b`, 2026-07-12T04:09Z). **PROP-135 + PROP-129 (added 2026-07-15 after PROP-130 fired 3 consecutive days on commits `27bf1e4b`/`19b70279`/`25a4825`):** structural source-side fix + enforcement backstop. PROP-135 codifies a fresh-git-base rule in `monitor/prompts/reference/decider-reporting.md` Step 8 — decider must base status.json updates on git-HEAD (via clone), field-merge decider-owned fields, newest-poll wins. Kills the chimera at source with zero hot-path code. PROP-129 adds CHECK 4 to the workspace-sync pre-push hook — monotonic-timestamp guard for status.json fields (`last_poll`, `last_run`, `last_analysis`); blocks any push that regresses a listed timestamp, override at `monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-monotonic-override.flag`, fail-open on internal error per CHECK 3 precedent. Together: PROP-135 prevents decider from producing chimeras; CHECK 4 catches the same shape from any other writer.
